# Orleia

> Orleia is a free, local-first AI productivity suite: habits, tasks, notes, journal, a smart calendar, presentations (Deck), deep research with citations, and Noor — a built-in AI assistant with three selectable models, vision, voice input, and image generation. All user data stays in the user's own browser; there are no accounts and no cloud storage.

Orleia requires no sign-up: open the app and start. It works offline after first load and installs as a PWA on iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux. A native-quality desktop build is also available for Windows and Linux.

## Core capabilities

- Dashboard: a personal daily overview of habits, tasks, and reminders
- Habits: streaks, schedules, monthly history
- Tasks: list, Kanban, and calendar views with drag-and-drop
- Notes and Documents: fast local notes and rich documents
- Journal (Mindfulness): mood tracking, guided breathing exercises, meditation timer
- Calendar: month/week scheduling with reminders
- Deck: AI-drafted presentations with themes, charts, images, and export
- Noor AI assistant: web search, deep research reports with citations, image generation, vision (image understanding), voice input, and workspace actions (create/complete tasks, habits, notes, reminders)
- Web Search 2.0: multi-step research that reads pages and produces cited briefs, deliverables, and Deck exports

## Key facts

- Pricing: completely free; no paid tiers
- Accounts: none — no email, no sign-up; an optional local password protects data on the user's own device
- Data: stored locally in the browser (IndexedDB/localStorage); nothing is uploaded
- AI: requests are relayed without storing conversations; models may be referenced as Ethos, Logos, and Verse
- Platforms: Web (PWA), Windows, Linux
- Languages: 19 UI languages, auto-selected from the operating system
- Privacy: no third-party trackers, no ads, no data selling; aggregate, cookie-less analytics only
